card.title: Nintendo Switch Diagnostics: Power, BQ24193, M92T36 & PI3USB30532 Checks

claims.statement: A shorted capacitor behind the CPU on the back of the motherboard indicates a dead CPU/board.
claims.evidence: If one of those capacitors behind the CPU is shorted, the switch is trashed.
claims.quote: There is an area full of capacitor, right behind the CPU, if one of those capacitors is shorted, the switch is trashed.

claims.statement: M92T36 input pin 5 and output pin 6 should both measure between 3V and 6V DC when power is triggered.
claims.evidence: 0V on pin 6 indicates M92T36 is bad, while 0V on pin 5 indicates a short on the input line.
claims.quote: In that pin you are supposed to have 3v to 6v. If you have 0v or less, you have a short on that line... 0v in pin 6 means M92T36 is bad.

claims.statement: BQ24193 pin 1 VBUS voltage depends on charger input and should read 5V to 15V DC.
claims.evidence: When plugging a charger into the switch, pin 1 VBus should read high 5V-15V.
claims.quote: Check the voltages on BQ24193 Pin 1 VBus should be high 5v-15v depending on charger

claims.statement: BQ24193 charging temperature circuit relies on critical 3.8k and 5.6k ohm resistor values.
claims.evidence: Replacing the 5.6k resistor with 10k causes BQ24193 to fail to charge due to out-of-range temperature sensing.
claims.quote: For example if you replace the 5.6kohm resistor with 10k ,bq 24193 will not charge the battery because the temp set for charghing will bee out of range.

claims.statement: PI3USB30532 handles USB 3.0 and DisplayPort 1.2 switching for dock HDMI output.
claims.evidence: PI3USB30532 is a 6:4 differential channel matrix switch routing USB 3.0 SuperSpeed and DP1.2 signals.
claims.quote: PI3USB30532, a "6:4 differential channel bi-directional matrix switch solution for switching USB3.0 and/or DP1.2 signals through USB3.0 Type-C connector"

procedure: Check USB charger fuse for continuity with battery disconnected.
Measure battery voltage on red cables before and after 30 minutes of charging to confirm BQ24193 operation.
Check all motherboard capacitors for shorts to ground using continuity mode with black probe on ground.
Connect battery, press power button, and measure DC voltage at pin 5 and pin 6 of M92T36 IC (expect 3V to 6V).
Visually inspect screen and backlight ribbon cables and connectors.
If non-booting or blank screen, attempt hard reset by holding power button for 15-20 seconds, waiting 4-10 seconds, then powering on.
If RCM payload injection fails and display shows no image, inspect PI3USB30532 IC, its pin pads, filters, and surrounding passive components.

cautions: Do not remove the eMMC chip during general short checking as it is difficult to reinstall.
Do not overheat the motherboard while replacing the USB-C port to prevent PCB bubbling.
SOURCE RISK: Third-party docks or incorrect charging cables can output improper voltages, damaging the ICs or bricking the console.
card.caveats: Measurements on TS1/TS2 resistors must be taken out of circuit for accurate resistance values.
